verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              प्रयाते तव सैन्यं तु युयुधाने युयुत्सया।  धर्मराजो महाराज स्वेनानीकेन संवृतः॥१॥
प्रायाद्द्रोणरथं प्रेप्सुर्युयुधानस्य पृष्ठतः।  ततः पाञ्चालराजस्य पुत्रः समरदुर्मदः॥२॥
verses.english: Followed Yuyudhana from behind, with a view to reach the chariot of Drona. Thereafter, the son of the king of the Panchalas, that invincible warrior.

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्रोशत्पाण्डवानीके वसुदानश्च पार्थिवः।  आगच्छत प्रहरत द्रुतं विपरिधावत ॥३॥
यथा सुखेन गच्छेत सात्यकिर्युद्धदुर्मदः।  महारथा हि बहवो यतिष्यन्त्यस्य निर्जये ॥४॥
verses.english: So that the invincible Satyaki may proceed easily. Many mighty car-warriors will strive hard for vanquishing him.'

verses.sanskrit: इति ब्रुवन्तो वेगेन निपेतुस्ते महारथाः।  वयं प्रतिजिगीषन्तस्तत्र तान् समभिद्रुताः ॥५॥
verses.english: Thus speaking, the mighty car-warriors of the Pandavas impetuously dashed against us. Indeed they then feel upon us exclaiming "we will conquer those who will rush against ourselves."

verses.sanskrit: ततः शब्दो महानासीद्युयुधानरथं प्रति।  आकीर्यमाणा धावन्ती तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनी॥६॥
verses.english: Then a mighty uproar was heard nec. the car of Yuyudhana. Your son's troops, then covered with the shafts of Satyaki, began to run away from the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit: सात्वतेन महाराज शतधाऽभिव्यशीर्यत।  तस्यां विदीर्यमाणायां शिनेः पुत्रो महारथः॥७॥
verses.english: O mighty monarch, your troops were then broken to hundred straggling bodies by that hero of the Satvata race. While that army was thus confused, that mighty car-warrior, the grandson of Sini.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तवीरान् महेष्वासानग्रानीकेष्वपोथयत्।  अथान्यानपि राजेन्द्र नानाजनपदेश्वरान् ॥८॥
verses.english: Crushed down seven fierce bowmen all endued with heroism in the vanguard of our army. He also, O monarch, dispatched, with his arrows resembling the tongues of fire, to the abode of death, many heroic rulers of diverse realms. Sometimes he pierced hundred warriors with a single shaft and sometimes a single warriors with a hundred shafts.

verses.sanskrit: शरैरनलसंकाशैर्निन्ये वीरान्यमक्षयम्।  शतमेकेन विव्याध शतेनैकं च पत्रिणाम् ॥९॥
द्विपारोहान् ‌द्विपांश्चैव हयारोहान् हयांस्तथा।  रथिनः साश्वसुतांच जघानेशः पशूनिव॥१०॥
verses.english: Elephant-riders and elephants, horse-men and horses and car-warriors and their steeds and charioteers, Satyaki slew like Rudra slaying the beasts.

verses.sanskrit: तं तथाऽद्भुतकर्माणं शरसंपातवर्षिणम्।  न केचनाभ्यधावन् वै सात्यकिं तव सैनिकाः॥११॥
ते भीता मृद्यमानाश्च प्रसृष्टा दीर्घबाहुना। आयोधनं जहुर्वीरा दृष्ट्वा तमतिमानिनम्॥१२॥
verses.english: They were then seized with panic being crushed and mangled by that long-armed hero; and beholding that proud hero, they then began to run quickly away from the field of battle,

verses.sanskrit: तमेकं बहुधाऽपश्यन् मोहितास्तस्य तेजसा।  रथैर्विमथितैश्चैव भग्ननीडैश्च मारिष ॥१३॥
verses.english: Although Satyaki was alone yet, your troops thought him to be multiplied into many. They were then confounded by his energy. Then with shattered chariots and crushed carniches.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रैर्विमथितैश्छत्रैर्ध्वजैश्च विनिपातितैः।  अनुकर्षैः पताकाभिः शिरस्त्राणैः सकाञ्चनैः॥१४॥
verses.english: With Anukarsha, bannerets, golden helmets, broken wheels, torn umbrellas and fallen standards.

verses.sanskrit: बाहुभिश्चन्दनादिग्धैः साङ्गदैश्च विशांपते।  हस्तिहस्तोपमैश्चापि भुजङ्गाभोगसन्निभैः ॥१५॥
verses.english: And O ruler of men, with arms decked with sandal-paste, adorned with Angadas, with human thighs, resembling trunks of elephants or the plump bodies of snakes, the earth became literally covered over. With faces resembling the moon and with heads graced with beautiful ear-rings.

verses.sanskrit: ऊरुभिः पृथिवी च्छन्ना मनुजानां नराधिप।  शशाङ्कसन्निभैश्चैव वदनैश्चारुकुण्डलैः ॥१६॥
पतितैर्ऋषभाक्षाणां सा बभावति मेदिनी।  गजैश्च बहुधा छिन्नैः शयानैः पर्वतोपमैः ॥१७॥
verses.english: Of warriors possessed of expansive eyes, the earth appeared exceedingly charming. With the mountain-like bodies of huge elephants cut to pieces and fallen on the field.

verses.sanskrit: रराजातिभृशं भूमिर्विकीर्णैरिव पर्वतैः।  तपनीयमयैर्योक्त्रैर्मुक्ताजालविभूषितैः ॥१८॥
verses.english: The ground, strewn with mangled elephants and their drivers and with broken standards appeared as if it were covered over with hills.

verses.sanskrit: उरश्छदैर्विचित्रैश्च व्यशोभन्त तुरंगमाः।  गतसत्त्वा महीं प्राप्य प्रमृष्टा दीर्घबाहुना॥१९॥
नानाविधानि सैन्यानि तव हत्वा तु सात्वतः।  प्रविष्टस्तावकं सैन्यं द्रावयित्वा चमूं भृशम्॥२०॥
verses.english: Then he of the Satvata race penetrated into the ranks of your army slaying troops of diverse kinds and crushing your army completely.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेनैव मार्गेण येन यातो धनञ्जयः।  इयेष सात्यकिर्गन्तुं ततो द्रोणेन वारितः॥२१॥
भारद्वाजं समासाद्य युयुधानश्च सात्यकिः।  न न्यवर्तत संक्रुद्धो वेलामिव जलाशयः॥२२॥
verses.english: Then the war-like Satyaki, inflamed as he was with rage, did not recede getting Drona as an opponent, even as the waters of the ocean does not recede encountering an embankment.

verses.sanskrit: निवार्य तु रणे द्रोणो युयुधानं महारथम्।  विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैः पञ्चभिर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥२३॥
verses.english: Resisting that mighty car-warrior Yuyudhana in battle, Drona pierced him with five sharp arrows all capable of penetrating to the very vitals.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिस्तु रणे द्रोणं राजन् विव्याध सप्तभिः।  हेमपुंखैः शिलाधौतैः कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः॥२४॥
verses.english: Thereupon, O king, Satyaki in that battle, pierced Drona with seven arrows whetted on stone and furnished with golden wings as well as with wings made of the feathers of the Kanka and the peacock.

verses.sanskrit: तं षड्भिः सायकैर्द्रोणः साश्वयन्तारमार्दयत्।  स तं न ममृषे द्रोणं युयुधानो महारथः ॥२५॥
सिंहनादं ततः कृत्वा द्रोणं विव्याध सात्यकिः।  दशभिः सायकैश्चान्यैः षड्भिरष्टाभिरेव च ॥२६॥
verses.english: Uttering his war-cry aloud, Satyaki then pierced Drona at first with ten, then with six and again with eight arrows.

verses.sanskrit: युयुधानः पुनर्द्रोणं विव्याध दशभिः शरैः। एकेन सारथिं चास्य चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥२७॥
ध्वजमेकेन बाणेन विव्याध युधि मारिष। तं द्रोणः साश्वयन्तारं सरथध्वजमाशुगैः॥२८॥
verses.english: O sire in that battle, he pierced Drona's standard with another arrows. Thereupon Drona quickly discharging his swift-flying arrows that resembled fights of locusts, covered Satyaki together with his steeds, charioteer, chariot and standard. So also Yuyudhana with countless swift-coursing shafts.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरन् प्राच्छादयद्बाणैः शलभानामिव व्रजैः। तथैव युयुधानोऽपि द्रोणं बहुभिराशुगैः ॥२९॥
आच्छादयदसंभ्रान्तस्ततो द्रोण उवाच ह। तवाचार्यो रणं हित्वा गतः कापुरुषो यथा॥३०॥
verses.english: Covered Drona fearlessly; then Drona addressing him said-”Your preceptor has gone before, shunning me in battle as a veritable coward.

verses.sanskrit: युध्यमानं च मां हित्वा प्रदक्षिणमवर्तत।  त्वं हि मे युध्यतो नाद्य जीवन् यास्यसि माधव॥३१॥
verses.english: He avoided me though I was fighting and proceeded keeping me in the right. You shall not, escape me today with life, provided you also do not shun me fighting, like your cowardly preceptor."

verses.sanskrit: यदि मां त्वं रणे हित्वा न यास्याचार्यवद्द्रुतम्। सात्यकिरुवाच। धनञ्जयस्य पदवीं धर्मराजस्य शासनात्॥३२॥
verses.english: Satyaki said At the command of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira, I am proceeding in the track of Dhananjaya. Good betide you, O Brahman. Let me lose no time.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छामि स्वस्ति ते ब्रह्मन्न मे कालात्ययो भवेत्।  आचार्यानुगतो मार्गः शिष्यैरन्वास्यते सदा॥३३॥
verses.english: The path which the preceptor follows it that which the pupil should follow. Therefore, I shall quickly follow that which my preceptor has followed.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मादेव व्रजाम्याशु यथा मे स गुरुर्गतः।
              सञ्जय उवाच।
              एतावदुक्त्वा शैनेय आचार्यं परिवर्जयन् ॥३४॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, that grandson of Sini, dashed forward avoiding the preceptor; and O king, then addressing his charioteer he said

verses.sanskrit: प्रयातः सहसा राजन् सारथिं चेदमब्रवीत्।  द्रोणः करिष्यते यत्नं सर्वथा मम वारणे ॥३५॥
verses.english: "Drona will put forth every effort to check me in battle. So proceed very carefully. Hear also these words of mine of grave import.

verses.sanskrit: यत्तो याहि रणे सूत शृणु चेदं वचः परम्।  एतदालोक्यते सैन्यमावन्त्यानां महाप्रभम्॥३६॥
verses.english: Yonder is seen the highly resplendent division of the Avantis. Next to them is the mighty host composed of the warriors from the south.

verses.sanskrit: अस्यानन्तरतस्त्वेतद्दाक्षिणात्यं महद्बलम्।  तदनन्तरमेतच्च बाल्हिकानां महद्बलम् ॥३७॥
verses.english: Beyond this latter array is the division of the Valhikas, beyond which again stand the division of Karna, firmly resolved to fight.

verses.sanskrit: बाल्हिकाभ्याशतो युक्तं कर्णस्य च महद्बलम्।  अन्योन्येन हि सैन्यानि भिन्नान्येतानि सारथे॥३८॥
verses.english: O charioteer, though these divisions are distinct from one another, yet depending on one another, they are supporting one another.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यं समुपाश्रित्य न त्यक्ष्यन्ति रणाजिरम्।  एतदन्तरमासाद्य चोदयाश्वान् प्रहृष्टवत् ॥३९॥
verses.english: Penetrating into these divisions, do you cheerfully urge the steeds on. O charioteer, carry me in a medium speed to the spot.

verses.sanskrit: मध्यमं जयमास्थाय वह मामत्र सारथे। बाल्हिका यत्र दृश्यन्ते नानाप्रहरणोद्यताः॥४०॥
verses.english: Where the Valhikas are seen stationed with weapons uplifted, where stand the numerous Southerners headed by Suta's son Karna;

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षिणात्याश्च बहवः सूतपुत्रपुरोगमाः।  हस्त्यश्वरथसंबाधं यच्चानीकं विलोक्यते॥४१॥
नानादेशसमुत्थैश्च पदातिभिरधिष्ठितम्।  एतावदुक्त्वा यन्तारं ब्राह्मणं परिवर्जयन्॥४२॥
verses.english: And where stands that division teeming with elephants, horses and cars and foot-soldiers recruited from various realms.

verses.sanskrit: मध्यतो याहि यत्रोग्रं कर्णस्य च महद्बलम्।  तं द्रोणोऽनुययौ क्रुद्धो विकिरन् विशिखान् बहून् ॥४३॥
verses.english: Having thus spoken and avoiding the Brahmana, he advanced addressing his charioteer thus, "Pass through the breach between those two divisions towards the mighty and fierce host of Karna.

verses.sanskrit: युयुधानं महाभागं गच्छन्तमनिवर्तिनम्।  कर्णस्य सैन्यं सुमहद‌भिहत्य शितैः शरैः॥४४॥
verses.english: Thereupon, inflamed with rage, Drona began to pursue the illustrious Yuyudhana who was proceeding steadily, discharging numerous arrows.

verses.sanskrit: प्राविशद्भारतीं सेनामपर्यन्तां च सात्यकिः।  प्रविष्टे युयुधाने तु सैनिकेषु द्रुतेषु च ॥४५॥
verses.english: Then Satyaki afflicting Karna's mighty host with his sharp arrows, plunged into che infinite host of the Bharatas.

verses.sanskrit: अमर्षी कृतवर्मा तु सात्यकिं पर्यवारयत्।  तमापतन्तं विशिखैः पड्भिराहत्य सात्यकिः॥४६॥
verses.english: When Yuyudhana had thus entered into the ranks of your soldiers and when your soldiers were breaking away, Kritavarman inspired with rage opposed Satyaki.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भिश्चतुरोऽस्याश्वानाजघानाशु वीर्यवान्।  ततः पुनः षोडशभिर्नतपर्वभिराशुगैः ॥४७॥
verses.english: The highly-puissant Satyaki struck him as he was advancing with six arrows; and then with four other shafts, he slew the latter's four steeds.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे।  स ताड्यमानो विशिखैर्बहुभिस्तिग्मतेजनैः ॥४८॥
सात्वतेन महाराज कृतवर्मा न चक्षमे।  स वत्सदन्तं सन्धाय जिह्मगानिलसन्निभम्॥४९॥
verses.english: O mighty monarch, thus pierced with numerous arrows of great fierceness by that Satvata hero, Kritvarman did not brook it. arrow

verses.sanskrit: आकृष्य राजन्नाकर्णाद्विव्याधोरसि सात्यकिम्।  स तस्य देहावरणं भित्वा देहं च सायकः ॥५०॥
verses.english: Placing a Vatsadantha, capable of flying straight and resembling fire, O king, on the string of his bow, Kritavarman drew it back to his very ears and with that arrow then pierced Satyaki on the breast.

verses.sanskrit: स पुंखपत्रः पृथिवीं विवेश रुधिरोक्षितः।  अथास्य बहुभिर्बाणैरच्छिनत् परमास्त्रवित् ॥५१॥
verses.english: That furnished with beautiful feathery wings, penetrating through the armour and body of Satyaki, entered the earth, being steeped in blood.

verses.sanskrit: स मार्गणगणं राजन् कृतवर्मा शरासनम्।  विव्याध च रणे राजन् सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम्॥५२॥
दशभिर्विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिक्रुद्धः स्तनान्तरे।  ततः प्रशीर्णे धनुषि शक्त्या शक्तिमतां वरः॥५३॥
verses.english: Then again inflamed with rage, he pierced, O king, Satyaki of indomitable prowess on the chest, with ten shafts of great sharpness.

verses.sanskrit: जघान दक्षिणं बाहुं सात्यकिः कृतवर्मणः।  ततोऽन्यत् सुदृढं चापं पूर्णमायम्य सात्यकिः॥५४॥
verses.english: Thereat that foremost of all creatures endued with prowess, viz., Satyaki, seeing his bow cut asunder, wounded the right arm of Kritavarman with an excellent lance.

verses.sanskrit: व्यसृजद्विशिखांस्तूर्णं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।  सरथं कृतवर्माणं समन्तात् पर्यवारयत् ॥५५॥
verses.english: Then taking up and stretching a bow of tougher make, Yuyudhana swiftly discharged at his enemy hundreds and thousands of shafts;

verses.sanskrit: छादयित्वा रणे राजन् हार्दिक्यं स तु सात्यकिः।  अथास्य भल्लेन शिरः सारथेः समकृन्तत ॥५६॥
स पपात हतः सूतो हार्दिक्यस्य महारथात्।  ततस्ते यन्तृरहिताः प्राद्रवंस्तुरगा भृशम् ॥५७॥
verses.english: Cut off with a bhalla the head of the charioteer of his opponent, from his trunk. Thus slain, the driver of Kritavarman fell down from his niche of the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: अथ भोजस्तु संभ्रान्तो निगृह्य तुरगान् स्वयम्।  तस्थौ वीरो धनुष्पाणिस्तत् सैन्यान्यभ्यपूजयन् ॥५८॥
verses.english: At this, the steeds of Kritavarman no longer guided by the driver's reins, flew away with great speed, from the field of battle. Thereat. greatly annoved, the ruler of the Bhojas, himself checked his horses.

verses.sanskrit: स मुहूर्तमिवाश्वस्य सदश्वान् समनोदयत्।  व्यपेतभीरमित्राणामावहत् सुमहद्भयम् ॥५९॥
verses.english: Then that heroic warrior stood bou in hand, ready once more for fight, sceing which your Warrior applauded him highly. Taking respite for a moment only, Kritavarman urged his stecds on.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिश्चाभ्यगात्तस्मात्स तु भीममुपाद्रवत्।  युयुधानोऽपि राजेन्द्र भोजानीकाद्विनिःसृतः॥६०॥
verses.english: Himself quite undaunted, he struck terror into the hearts of his enemies. By this time however, Satyaki had proceeded leaving him behind; whereupon Kritavarman fell upon Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: प्रययौ त्वरितस्तूर्णं काम्बोजानां महाचमूम्।  स तत्र बहुभिः शूरैः सन्निरुद्धो महारथैः ॥६१॥
verses.english: O mighty monarch, Yuyudhana also cmerging out of the division of the Bhojas, quickly proceeded against the strong host of the Kambojas.

verses.sanskrit: न चचाल तदा राजन्सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः।  संधाय च चमूं द्रोणो भाजे भारं निवश्य च॥६२॥
verses.english: There he was opposed by many heroic carwarriors; in consequence whereof, Satyaki of uobaffled prowess could not move even one step forward.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यधाव‌द्रणे यत्तो युयुधानं युयुत्सया।  तथा तमनुधावन्त युयुधानस्य पृष्ठतः ॥६३॥
verses.english: Thereafter uniting his troops and vesting the ruler of the Bhojas' with their command, Drona with a firm resolve for fighting with Yuyudhana, rushed against him.

verses.sanskrit: न्यवारयन्त संहृष्टाः पाण्डुसैन्ये बृहत्तमाः।  समासाद्य तु हार्दिक्यं रथानां प्रवरं रथम् ॥६४॥
पञ्चाला विगतोत्साहा भीमसेनपुरोगमाः।  विक्रम्य वारिता राजन् वीरेण कृतवर्मणा ॥६५॥
verses.english: Meanwhile the Panchalas commanded by Bhimasena, encountering that foremost of carwarriors viz., Hridika's son, became greatly depressed at heart.

verses.sanskrit: यतमानांश्च तान् सर्वानीषद्विगतचेतसः।  अभितस्तान् शरौघेण क्लान्तवाहानकारयत्॥६६॥
verses.english: O king, then putting forth his energy, the heroic Kritavarman resisted all his focs who though depressed at first were then exerting vigorously.

verses.sanskrit: निगृहीतास्तु भोजेन भोजानीकेप्सवो रणे।  अतिष्ठन्नार्यवद्वीराः प्रार्थयन्तो महद्यशः ॥६७॥
